name: Fipexide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1990 — for liver harm, breathing problems and nerve and brain harm

summary: Fipexide was pulled from the market in France beginning in 1990 due to concerns involving liver harm, breathing problems, and damage to the nerves and brain [3]. In addition, a small computer model rather than testing on humans estimated a medium score of 58 for liver risks and a high score of 74 for heart risks [M]. These computer-generated numbers and historical regulatory actions outline the documented warning signs linked to the drug [3][M].
